A circle is inscribed in ΔABC, touching AB, BC
and AC at the points P, Q and R, respectively. If AB -
BC = 4 cm, AB - AC = 2 cm and the perimeter of

Let AB = c, BC = a, AC = b.
Given:
c - a = 4
c - b = 2
a + b + c = 36
From a = c - 4, b = c - 2:
(c - 4) + (c - 2) + c = 36
3c - 6 = 36
c = 14
So a = 10, b = 12.
For an incircle:
PB = s - b and AR = s - a, where s = 36/2 = 18.
Thus:
PB = 18 - 12 = 6
AR = 18 - 10 = 8
PB + AR = 14.

records.question_text:
If PQR is an equilateral triangle inscribed in a
circle and S and T are two points on the circle, find
∠QTR & ∠QSR.

explanation.text:
In equilateral △PQR each angle is 60°, so the chord QR subtends 60° at P
Angles in the same segment are equal, so the point on the same side as P gives ∠QTR = 60°
Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral add to 180°, so the point on the other arc gives ∠QSR = 180 − 60 = 120°
The angles are 60° and 120°

records.question_text:
A quadrilateral ABCD has a circle inscribed
within it. Given that the lengths of sides AB, BC, and
CD are 6 cm, 7 cm, and 8 cm respectively, what is
the length of side AD?

explanation.text:
In a quadrilateral having an inscribed circle, the two pairs of opposite sides have equal sums: AB + CD = BC + AD
6 + 8 = 7 + AD
AD = 7 cm

records.question_text:
The angle between two tangents from an
external point to a circle is equal to the angle
subtended by the chord of contact at the center.
What is the relationship between this angle and the
angle subtended by the chord at the circumference?

d.text: The relationship depends on the radius.

explanation.text:
The chord of contact subtends a certain angle at the centre, and the same chord also subtends an angle at the circumference
The angle at the centre is always twice the angle at the circumference standing on the same chord
One angle is twice the other

subset_structure.selection_rule: For each generated 25-question test, select one question from each of five chosen subsets; the selected question inside each subset may be randomized. A subset may contribute at most 2 questions when the generation rule explicitly requires it, but the preferred/default rule is 1 per chosen subset.
subset_structure.no_consecutive_subset_rule: After selection, randomize final question order so source/set/subset order is not continuous.

test_generation_rule.repeat_policy: never select the same question_id twice in one test
test_generation_rule.used_question_policy: remove selected question only from current test-generation pool; never delete from master database
test_generation_rule.randomization: random pick inside each bucket, then shuffle final 25-question order
test_generation_rule.validation: 25 unique question_ids and exactly one question from every bucket

math_rendering.source_preservation: Original source-faithful Unicode math is preserved in question_text/options/explanation.
math_rendering.input_format: LaTeX where a dedicated math_latex field is supplied; otherwise render the preserved Unicode math text.
math_rendering.verification_status: Missing/extracted mathematical formulas were visually verified against the original source PDF and added as verified LaTeX where source-supported.
math_rendering.unverified_missing_formula_policy: If a source formula cannot be visually verified, do not invent it; preserve source text and mark it unresolved.
